# additive model: g(t) + linear/nonlinear in x,v, with g via binned means
from numpy.linalg import lstsq
def fit_add(nb, extra):
    edges=np.linspace(t.min(),t.max()+1e-9,nb+1)
    B=np.zeros((len(t),nb))
    idx=np.digitize(t,edges)-1
    B[np.arange(len(t)),idx]=1
    X=np.column_stack([B]+extra)
    b=lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.sum((X@b-dv_dt)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2), b[nb:]

import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
def M(p, tt=None):
    w,k,q=p[0],p[1],p[2]
    tt=t
    c=np.cos(w*tt); s=np.sin(w*tt)
    return np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),c,s,v,np.tanh(v),v*c,v*s,np.exp(-k*t)*c,np.exp(-k*t)*s])
def f(p):
    X=M(p); b=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]; return np.sum((X@b-dv_dt)**2)
best=None
for k0 in [-0.2,-0.05,0.0,0.05,0.2]:
    r=so.minimize(f,[0.39,k0,0],method='Nelder-Mead',options={'xatol':1e-9,'fatol':1e-12,'maxiter':4000})
    if best is None or r.fun<best.fun: best=r

def g(p):
    w,a=p
    tt=t
    ph=w*tt+a*tt*tt
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),np.cos(ph),np.sin(ph),v,np.tanh(v),v*np.cos(ph),v*np.sin(ph)])
    b=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dv_dt,rcond=None)[0]; return np.sum((X@b-dv_dt)**2)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    c = np.cos(p[9]*t); s = np.sin(p[9]*t); e = np.exp(0.2706*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*np.tanh(v) + p[3]*c + p[4]*s + p[5]*v*c + p[6]*v*s
            + p[7]*e*c + p[8]*e*s)
